capability_standard.name: an ACORD-style insurance capability model
capability_standard.note: The ACORD Framework is licensed to ACORD members. This pack uses its own capability wording and records only the reference domain name.

process_tiers.Operate: Value streams and the processes that serve policyholders directly
process_tiers.Manage: Processes that direct and control the insurer
process_tiers.Support: Processes that keep the insurer running

criticality.label: Critical or important function
criticality.help: A function whose disruption would materially impair the insurer's performance, its regulatory compliance or the continuity of its services (DORA; Solvency II outsourcing)
criticality.change_flag: Changes {n} application{s} supporting critical or important functions: follow ICT change management, assess the risk before release and update the register of information if suppliers change.

third_party.register: outsourcing register and DORA register of information
third_party.guidance: Solvency II outsourcing rules and DORA
third_party.view_sub: Outsourcing of critical or important functions and ICT third parties behind critical functions (Solvency II outsourcing rules, DORA): exit plans, contract terms and concentration.

resilience.note: Recovery targets and DR test history are illustrative until replaced with real data.

taxonomy_examples.commitment: One back office for all product lines
